name: PM-KISAN: income support to landholding farmer families
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
source_note: ILLUSTRATIVE SEED DATA. Criteria are simplified for the prototype and are not a substitute for the official scheme guidelines; replace before any real use.

criteria.clause_text: The applicant must be a landholding farmer family.
The applicant must be at least 18 years of age.
Households that pay income tax are not eligible.
Serving or retired government employees are excluded.
